Warranty

Three levels of cover. All of them in writing.

Every device includes 12 months against defects. If you want longer, or you run a fleet that cannot be without a device, there are two paid options with published prices and terms you can forward to your finance team.

Included

Standard

With every device

12 months against defects, 30-day returns. Included with every device.

  • 12 months against manufacturing defects from the date of delivery
  • 30-day returns for any reason, in original condition
  • Email support from someone who has handled the hardware

Add-on

3-Year Warranty

From £45 per device

Extends cover against defects to 36 months, adds battery cover, and we pay carriage both ways.

  • 36 months against manufacturing defects from the date of delivery
  • Battery covered: replaced or the device swapped if capacity falls below 80%
  • We pay carriage both ways within mainland UK
  • Repair or replacement, your choice of refund if we cannot do either
  • One price per device, added at checkout or on your quote

Fleets of 5+

Total Care

From £99 per device

36 months with a replacement dispatched next working day, a battery service at month 18 and set-up help. For fleets of 5 or more.

  • Everything in the 3-Year Warranty
  • Replacement dispatched next working day, before the faulty unit comes back
  • Battery service at month 18: new battery on the W10, capacity check and swap if needed on Android devices
  • Devices delivered set up with your apps and settings
  • A loan unit for trials and roll-outs
  • Take-back and a data-wipe certificate at end of life
  • For orders of 5 or more devices
Accidental damage. Accidental damage (a cracked screen, a drop that breaks the casing) is not covered by any tier yet. We will add it only when an authorised insurer underwrites it, and we will say so on this page when that happens.

Claims

How a claim works

  1. Email support@tugahardware.com with the order number, the serial number and what is wrong. Photos or a short video help.
  2. We reply within one working day with a returns label (3-Year Warranty) or confirm the replacement dispatch (Total Care).
  3. Send the faulty unit back in any suitable box. Under both paid tiers the carriage is on us.
  4. We repair or replace and send it back, or keep the replacement you already have under Total Care.
  5. Your cover continues for the rest of the original term on the repaired or replacement device.

The full terms for each level are in the Warranty section of our Terms. Nothing on this page replaces them, and nothing in them is different from this page.
